Whether a human agronomist reviewed a domain item (contract 1.2.0, D-025, D-030).

"none": reviewed by agents only (the app shows "Not yet reviewed by a local agronomist").
"local-agronomist": a local agronomist reviewed it; `approved_by` names them.

Provenance.description:
Provenance record attached to every data file (docs/DATA_POLICY.md §3).

All fourteen keys are always present. A record either cites a dataset completely (dataset, version,
provider, url and accessed all filled) or has `dataset: null` and says in `notes` what the content is
instead (synthetic demo content, user input, a domain table). No field may hold UNVERIFIED or an
unfilled <placeholder>.

id.description: Identifier of a provenance record, for example prov-<dataset>-<period>.

dataset.description: Exact product short name, or null when the file is not dataset-backed.

provider.description: Data provider, as named on the page that was opened.

url.description: Landing page or DOI that was actually opened.

anyOf.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601, with a 'Z' or '+00:00' offset.

aoi.description: Area-of-interest id the file was cut to.
